sources.title: Open311 GeoReport v2
sources.recordDescription: Non-emergency civic service request (311) API: the list of service types a jurisdiction accepts and the service requests filed against them, with status and location.
sources.license: Not stated on the specification page

fields.name: services.service_code
fields.description: The unique identifier for the service request type

fields.name: services.service_name
fields.description: The human readable name of the service request type

fields.name: services.description
fields.description: A brief description of the service request type.

fields.name: services.metadata
fields.description: Determines whether there are additional form fields for this service type. true : This service request type requires additional metadata so the client will need to make a call to the Service Definition method.

fields.name: services.type
fields.description: realtime : The service request ID will be returned immediately after the service request is submitted. batch : A token will be returned immediately after the service request is submitted. This token can then be later used to return the service request ID.

fields.name: services.keywords
fields.description: A comma separated list of tags or keywords to help users identify the request type. This can provide synonyms of the service_name and group.

fields.name: services.group
fields.description: A category to group this service type within. This provides a way to group several service request types under one category such as “sanitation”

fields.name: requests.service_request_id
fields.description: The unique ID of the service request created.

fields.name: requests.status
fields.description: The current status of the service request. open : it has been reported. closed : it has been resolved. Notes: Options: open , closed

means.conversion: open or closed; finer workflow states require explicit mapping and retention in status_notes

fields.name: requests.status_notes
fields.description: Explanation of why status was changed to current state or more details on current status than conveyed with status alone. Notes: May not be returned

fields.name: requests.service_name
fields.description: The human readable name of the service request type

fields.name: requests.service_code
fields.description: The unique identifier for the service request type

fields.name: requests.description
fields.description: A full description of the request or report submitted. Notes: This may contain line breaks, but not html or code. Otherwise, this is free form text limited to 4,000 characters.

fields.name: requests.agency_responsible
fields.description: The agency responsible for fulfilling or otherwise addressing the service request. Notes: May not be returned

fields.name: requests.service_notice
fields.description: Information about the action expected to fulfill the request or otherwise address the information reported. Notes: May not be returned

fields.name: requests.requested_datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the service request was made. Notes: Returned in w3 format, eg 2010-01-01T00:00:00Z

fields.name: requests.updated_datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the service request was last modified. For requests with status=closed, this will be the date the request was closed. Notes: Returned in w3 format, eg 2010-01-01T00:00:00Z

fields.name: requests.expected_datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the service request can be expected to be fulfilled. This may be based on a service-specific service level agreement. Notes: May not be returned

fields.name: requests.address
fields.description: Human readable address or description of location. Notes: This should be provided from most specific to most general geographic unit, eg address number or cross streets, street name, neighborhood/district, city/town/village, county, postal code.

fields.name: requests.address_id
fields.description: The internal address ID used by a jurisdictions master address repository or other addressing system.

fields.name: requests.zipcode
fields.description: The postal code for the location of the service request.

fields.name: requests.lat
fields.description: latitude using the (WGS84) projection.

fields.name: requests.long
fields.description: longitude using the (WGS84) projection.

fields.name: requests.media_url
fields.description: A URL to media associated with the request, eg an image. Notes: A convention for parsing media from this URL has yet to be established, so currently it will be done on a case by case basis much like Twitter.com does.
